source.note: single-card witness of the SOUGHT hole 'restriction-grant' (priority 1 enabler; holes.restriction-grant, proposed_stem modification:restriction, kind BEHAVIOR, slang pacifism/prison/lock). Pacifism is the canonical pacifism grant. Oracle (whole card): 'Enchant creature\nEnchanted creature can't attack or block.' The card is an Aura whose sole non-enchant clause imposes a can't-attack/can't-block restriction on the object it is attached to, so the restriction emit is THE witness with no incidental context. The AST is FAITHFUL, not a wish (hand-parsed gold at Fixtures/HandParsedCards/Pacifism.json): the second static ability parses to two ContinuousEffects on one StaticAbility — CantAttackEffect{ Target={ Kind: EnchantedOrEquipped } } (CR 508.1c) and CantBlockEffect{ Target={ Kind: EnchantedOrEquipped } } (CR 509.1c) — exactly the multi-effect-per-clause reading the effect docs describe for 'can't attack or block'. The restriction PARSES cleanly (no emit:unparsed, no diagnostics), so there is no parse gap to route. ADR-3 canonical: side=emit, kind=BEHAVIOR (modification supergroup: 'an object altered in place'), stem=modification:restriction. HOLE BURN-DOWN: modification:restriction has NO declared stem (it lives only in holes), so this witness CREATES the stem — the rollup will surface it with unpredicted:true. That is the POINT (a sought hole turned into a witnessed stem), not an error; the scaffold should promote modification:restriction from a hole to a declared stem. MISSING AXIS (surfaced, NOT invented): the hole proposes attrs 'restrict=attack|block', but there is NO 'restrict' axis in the closed attribute_axes set (color/combat/control/counter-type/delta/direction/duration/exclude_self/from/keyword/manner/owner/pt/qty/recipient/self/stat/subject/subtype/target/to/token). Following the boggart-brute precedent (bare modification:evasion + the evasion-kind axis surfaced, not invented), this gold witnesses the BARE stem and does NOT add an off-axis 'restrict' key — the restrict={attack,block} facet (AST-derivable from the CantAttackEffect + CantBlockEffect pair) is a proposed new closed axis for the scaffold to decide, recorded here and in the assertion, not smuggled in. The one attr witnessed is subject=attached, which IS on the closed subject axis (the modification:* sibling convention: modification:evasion/:flying/:keyword all carry subject). subject=attached is AST-derivable from Target.Kind=EnchantedOrEquipped (the restriction lands on the attached creature, CR 303.4 / 701.3 attach), a new value on the subject axis whose only prior value_seen was 'self' (self = the source restricts itself, e.g. Defender; attached = an Aura/Equipment grants the restriction to a distinct attached object — the essence of a restriction *grant*). No edhrec_rank in the testbed source — popularity omitted (not fabricated).
